WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1232
),
sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        i_manager_id,
        SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE (i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR
          (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
),
manager_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        i_manager_id,
        AVG(sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM sales_data
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
)
SELECT 
    sd.i_manager_id,
    sd.sum_sales,
    ma.avg_monthly_sales
FROM sales_data sd
JOIN manager_averages ma ON sd.i_manager_id = ma.i_manager_id
WHERE CASE WHEN ma.avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN ABS(sd.sum_sales - ma.avg_monthly_sales) / ma.avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY sd.i_manager_id, ma.avg_monthly_sales, sd.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
